speaker_name: Address by Mr. Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa
speaker_title: Address by Mr. Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa, President of the Republic of South Africa

paragraphs.text: President of the General Assembly, Secretary-General, Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen, seventy-five years ago, the United Nations was established to introduce a new world order to achieve peace in the world. It was the dawn of a new era of global cooperation, forged in the aftermath of one of the darkest periods in the history of humankind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
President of the General Assembly, Secretary-General, Excellencies, Ladies 
and Gentlemen, seventy-five years ago, the United Nations was established to 
introduce a new world order to achieve peace in the world. It was the dawn of a new 
era of global cooperation, forged in the aftermath of one of the darkest periods in the 
history of humankind.

paragraphs.text: In 1945, the world was in crisis. It was counting the devastation wrought by war, devastation and plunder. Today, we are in the throes of another crisis — the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic. If we are to build a common and inclusive future in the aftermath of COVID-19, it is this solidarity that must endure. In the words of Nelson Mandela: “It is human solidarity, the concern for the other, that must be at the centre of the values by which we all live.”
paragraphs.raw_text:
In 1945, the world was in crisis. It was counting the devastation wrought 
by war, devastation and plunder. Today, we are in the throes of another crisis  — 
the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic. If we are to build a common and 
inclusive future in the aftermath of COVID-19, it is this solidarity that must endure. 
In the words of Nelson Mandela: “It is human solidarity, the concern for the other, 
that must be at the centre of the values by which we all live.”

paragraphs.text: As the African continent, our response to coronavirus has been swift and effective. We have a continental strategy to fight the pandemic being driven by the regional economic communities. The African Union has established a COVID-19 Response Fund and launched a ground-breaking African Medical Supplies Platform to ensure all countries have access to the necessary equipment and supplies.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As the African continent, our response to coronavirus has been swift and 
effective. We have a continental strategy to fight the pandemic being driven by the 
regional economic communities. The African Union has established a COVID-19 
Response Fund and launched a ground-breaking African Medical Supplies Platform 
to ensure all countries have access to the necessary equipment and supplies.

paragraphs.text: Nonetheless, the pandemic will inevitably set back our developmental aspirations. The resources we have had to redirect to fighting the pandemic have set back our efforts to provide housing, health care, water and sanitation and education to our people.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Nonetheless, the pandemic will inevitably set back our developmental 
aspirations. The resources we have had to redirect to fighting the pandemic have set 
back our efforts to provide housing, health care, water and sanitation and education 
to our people.

paragraphs.text: When the Secretary-General António Guterres delivered the 18th Nelson Mandela Annual Lecture in July 2020, he called on the nations of the world to forge a New Social Contract and a New Global Deal.
paragraphs.raw_text:
When the Secretary-General António Guterres delivered the 18th Nelson 
Mandela Annual Lecture in July 2020, he called on the nations of the world to forge 
a New Social Contract and a New Global Deal.

paragraphs.text: He said we must create equal opportunities for all, that we must advancea more inclusive and balanced multilateral trading system, that debt architecture must be reformed, and that there should be greater access to affordable credit for developing countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
He said we must create equal opportunities for all, that we must advancea 
more inclusive and balanced multilateral trading system, that debt architecture 
must be reformed, and that there should be greater access to affordable credit for 

developing countries.

paragraphs.text: It is a call we as South Africa wholly endorse.
paragraphs.raw_text: It is a call we as South Africa wholly endorse.

paragraphs.text: It is in the spirit of this New Global Deal, that we call on the international community and our international partners to support the rollout of a comprehensive stimulus package for Africa.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is in the spirit of this New Global Deal, that we call on the international 
community and our international partners to support the rollout of a comprehensive 
stimulus package for Africa.

paragraphs.text: This will enable African countries to not only mitigate the health impacts of COVID-19 but to aid us in the immense task of rebuilding our shattered economies.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This will enable African countries to not only mitigate the health impacts of 
COVID-19 but to aid us in the immense task of rebuilding our shattered economies.

paragraphs.text: To ensure that no country is left behind we reiterate our position as the African Union that economic sanctions against Zimbabwe and Sudan be lifted to allow their governments to respond adequately to the pandemic. We also call for the suspension of interest payments on Africa’s external and public debt.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To ensure that no country is left behind we reiterate our position as the African 
Union that economic sanctions against Zimbabwe and Sudan be lifted to allow their 
governments to respond adequately to the pandemic. We also call for the suspension 
of interest payments on Africa’s external and public debt.

paragraphs.text: As the African Union we are encouraged by the collaboration of the G20, the IMF, the World Bank and the UN towards finding solutions to debt sustainability in developing countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As the African Union we are encouraged by the collaboration of the G20, the 
IMF, the World Bank and the UN towards finding solutions to debt sustainability in 
developing countries.

paragraphs.text: This pandemic has highlighted the urgency with which we must strive to meet all the Sustainable Development Goals, but importantly Goal 1 — to end poverty in all its forms everywhere.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This pandemic has highlighted the urgency with which we must strive to meet 
all the Sustainable Development Goals, but importantly Goal 1 — to end poverty in 
all its forms everywhere.

paragraphs.text: For until we eradicate global poverty, we will always fall short of realising the vision of the founders of the United Nations .
paragraphs.raw_text:
For until we eradicate global poverty, we will always fall short of realising the 
vision of the founders of the United Nations .

paragraphs.text: We must expand economic opportunities to all our people, but most especially to the young, to women and to vulnerable persons.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must expand economic opportunities to all our people, but most especially 
to the young, to women and to vulnerable persons.

paragraphs.text: We must boldly pursue avenues of redistribution and redress as a means of advancing shared prosperity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must boldly pursue avenues of redistribution and redress as a means of 
advancing shared prosperity.

paragraphs.text: We must deal decisively with the rot of corruption that is robbing our people of the opportunities and services that are their right.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must deal decisively with the rot of corruption that is robbing our people of 
the opportunities and services that are their right.

paragraphs.text: Together, we must raise our level of ambition to ensure that every man, woman and child has an equal chance at a better future.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Together, we must raise our level of ambition to ensure that every man, woman 
and child has an equal chance at a better future.

paragraphs.text: It is a future free of hunger, disease, insecurity and war.
paragraphs.raw_text: It is a future free of hunger, disease, insecurity and war.

paragraphs.text: It is a world that affirms the dignity and worth of all, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religious affiliation or social circumstances.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a world that affirms the dignity and worth of all, regardless of race, 
ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religious affiliation or social circumstances.

paragraphs.text: The year 2020 will be remembered for the massive groundswell to push back the frontiers of racism under the umbrella of the #BlackLivesMatter movement.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The year 2020 will be remembered for the massive groundswell to push back 
the frontiers of racism under the umbrella of the #BlackLivesMatter movement.

paragraphs.text: As a country that has known too well the anguish of institutionalised racism, South Africa supports the demands for swift action against racism, whether committed by individuals, companies, officials or the state.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As a country that has known too well the anguish of institutionalised racism, 
South Africa supports the demands for swift action against racism, whether committed 
by individuals, companies, officials or the state.

paragraphs.text: South Africa calls on the United Nations to spare no effort to end prejudice and intolerance in all its forms and wherever it may be found.
paragraphs.raw_text:
South Africa calls on the United Nations to spare no effort to end prejudice and 
intolerance in all its forms and wherever it may be found.

paragraphs.text: In the words of Dr Martin Luther King Jnr:
paragraphs.raw_text: In the words of Dr Martin Luther King Jnr:

paragraphs.text: “Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.”
paragraphs.raw_text: “Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.”

paragraphs.text: As we mark the 25th Anniversary of the adoption of the Beijing Platform for Action, we must intensify our efforts to empower women and girls. It is the right of women and girls to be full and equal participants in the workplace, in political life and decision-making, in the economy, in obtaining an education and in society as a whole.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As we mark the 25th Anniversary of the adoption of the Beijing Platform for 
Action, we must intensify our efforts to empower women and girls. It is the right of 
women and girls to be full and equal participants in the workplace, in political life 
and decision-making, in the economy, in obtaining an education and in society as 
a whole.

paragraphs.text: South Africa is proud to be a member of the UN’s Generation Equality campaign and has prioritised the eradication of gender based violence and femicide.
paragraphs.raw_text:
South Africa is proud to be a member of the UN’s Generation Equality 
campaign and has prioritised the eradication of gender based violence and femicide.

paragraphs.text: At a continental level, we are working to finalise and adopt an AU Convention on Violence against Women during the course of this year.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At a continental level, we are working to finalise and adopt an AU Convention 
on Violence against Women during the course of this year.

paragraphs.text: AU member states are engaging on measures to promote financial inclusion, preferential procurement and preferential trade agreements for women.
paragraphs.raw_text:
AU member states are engaging on measures to promote financial inclusion, 
preferential procurement and preferential trade agreements for women.

paragraphs.text: As African countries we continue with our effort to ‘silence the guns’ once and for all through conflict resolution and peace-building.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As African countries we continue with our effort to ‘silence the guns’ once and 
for all through conflict resolution and peace-building.

paragraphs.text: Cooperation between the UN Security Council and the AU Peace and Security Council has contributed to improved peace and security in the Darfur region of Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, Mali and the Central African Republic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Cooperation between the UN Security Council and the AU Peace and Security 
Council has contributed to improved peace and security in the Darfur region of 
Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, Mali and the Central African Republic.

paragraphs.text: It is imperative that this collaboration is institutionalised and that the financing of AU peacekeeping operations is addressed and resolved.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is imperative that this collaboration is institutionalised and that the financing 
of AU peacekeeping operations is addressed and resolved.

paragraphs.text: South Africa is currently serving its second year as an elected non-permanent member of the United Nations Security Council.
paragraphs.raw_text:
South Africa is currently serving its second year as an elected non-permanent 
member of the United Nations Security Council.

paragraphs.text: We have used ourtenure to promote international peace and security by advocating for the peaceful settlement of disputes and inclusive dialogue.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We have used ourtenure to promote international peace and security by 
advocating for the peaceful settlement of disputes and inclusive dialogue.

paragraphs.text: The current composition of the Security Councildoes not reflectthe world in which we live.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The current composition of the Security Councildoes not reflectthe world in 
which we live.

paragraphs.text: On this 75th anniversary of the UN we repeat our call for greater representation of African countries on the Security Council,and that this be taken up with urgency at the Intergovernmental Negotiations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On this 75th anniversary of the UN we repeat our call for greater representation 
of African countries on the Security Council,and that this be taken up with urgency 
at the Intergovernmental Negotiations.

paragraphs.text: It is only through a reformed and inclusive Security Council that we will be able to collectively resolve some of the world’s most protracted conflicts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is only through a reformed and inclusive Security Council that we will be 
able to collectively resolve some of the world’s most protracted conflicts.

paragraphs.text: As we celebrate the founding of an organisation dedicated to freedom and equality, the people of Palestine and Western Sahara continue to live under occupation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As we celebrate the founding of an organisation dedicated to freedom and 
equality, the people of Palestine and Western Sahara continue to live under occupation.

paragraphs.text: We repeat our call for an end to the illegal occupation of Western Sahara and for the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We repeat our call for an end to the illegal occupation of Western Sahara and 
for the Palestinian people’s right to self-determination.

paragraphs.text: We further call for the lifting of the economic embargo and blockade of Cuba.
paragraphs.raw_text: We further call for the lifting of the economic embargo and blockade of Cuba.

paragraphs.text: Your Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Your Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: We have no choice but to work together to address the climate change crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text: We have no choice but to work together to address the climate change crisis.

paragraphs.text: As we rebuild in the aftermath of this pandemic we have an opportunity to place the global economy on a low-carbon, climate resilient developmental path.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As we rebuild in the aftermath of this pandemic we have an opportunity to 
place the global economy on a low-carbon, climate resilient developmental path.

paragraphs.text: We must advance the principles of the green and circular economies, not just for the sake of environmental sustainability but because of the opportunities for job creation and economic growth.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must advance the principles of the green and circular economies, not just 
for the sake of environmental sustainability but because of the opportunities for job 
creation and economic growth.

paragraphs.text: The global recovery effort must place climate change adaptation, mitigation and support at its centre — in line with the Paris Agreement and other multilateral environmental commitments.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The global recovery effort must place climate change adaptation, mitigation 
and support at its centre — in line with the Paris Agreement and other multilateral 
environmental commitments.

paragraphs.text: As the founders of the UN stood at a crossroads in 1945, so do we 75 years later.
paragraphs.raw_text:
As the founders of the UN stood at a crossroads in 1945, so do we 75 

years later.

paragraphs.text: They answered history’s call to craft a new order for a world in crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text: They answered history’s call to craft a new order for a world in crisis.

paragraphs.text: Today we battle the fires of a deadly pandemic, of racism and prejudice, of violence, war and extremism and, above all, of poverty and inequality.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today we battle the fires of a deadly pandemic, of racism and prejudice, of 
violence, war and extremism and, above all, of poverty and inequality.

paragraphs.text: The order we seek to build must be rooted in solidarity, equality and unity of purpose.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The order we seek to build must be rooted in solidarity, equality and unity 

of purpose.

paragraphs.text: The coronavirus pandemic has presented us with a choice.
paragraphs.raw_text: The coronavirus pandemic has presented us with a choice.

paragraphs.text: It is a choice between the global cooperation envisaged in the UN Charter or the pursuit of narrow self-interest and unilateralism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a choice between the global cooperation envisaged in the UN Charter or 
the pursuit of narrow self-interest and unilateralism.

paragraphs.text: It is a choice between tolerance or prejudice.
paragraphs.raw_text: It is a choice between tolerance or prejudice.

paragraphs.text: It is a choice between economic justice or growing inequality.
paragraphs.raw_text: It is a choice between economic justice or growing inequality.

paragraphs.text: The path we choose now will defermine our collective destiny.
paragraphs.raw_text: The path we choose now will defermine our collective destiny.

paragraphs.text: Though we face the most daunting of prospects, we have at our disposal the most potent force.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Though we face the most daunting of prospects, we have at our disposal the 
most potent force.

paragraphs.text: It is the solidarity and friendship upon which the United Nations was founded.
paragraphs.raw_text: It is the solidarity and friendship upon which the United Nations was founded.

paragraphs.text: When history faithfully records the global response to the worst health emergency of this century, let it be said that we stood and acted as one, that we provided leadership, and that we gave the peoples of all nations hope and courage.
paragraphs.raw_text:
When history faithfully records the global response to the worst health 
emergency of this century, let it be said that we stood and acted as one, that we 
provided leadership, and that we gave the peoples of all nations hope and courage.

paragraphs.text: The best, and most fitting, legacy of this 75th Session will be that through our actions we gave true meaning to the term ‘United Nations’.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The best, and most fitting, legacy of this 75th Session will be that through our 
actions we gave true meaning to the term ‘United Nations’.

paragraphs.text: South Africa reaffirms its commitment to the ideals and spirit of the UN Charter, and to sparing no effort to bring about a more just, peaceful and equitable world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
South Africa reaffirms its commitment to the ideals and spirit of the UN Charter, 
and to sparing no effort to bring about a more just, peaceful and equitable world.

paragraphs.text: May our cooperation deepen and may our solidarity endure.
paragraphs.raw_text: May our cooperation deepen and may our solidarity endure.

paragraphs.text: Let us make sure that all our efforts leave no woman, no child and no man behind, and that no nation is left behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let us make sure that all our efforts leave no woman, no child and no man 
behind, and that no nation is left behind.
